note: The closest thing in this batch to the ICP as stated. He owns an auto finance company he founded in 2013 — a business owner in the literal sense the quote calls for — and income was demonstrated rather than claimed: $6,000 paid in full within minutes of hearing the number, having declined the instalment option on the rep's advice. He is emphatically not deconditioned, having trained daily since fifteen, and he wants good to great, not rescue. The one miss is that health is not the neglected area: he trains every day and eats well. What is neglected is structure and enjoyment, which is a different problem from the one the ICP describes. That distinction matters for the audit — the criterion is written as though the buyer has let their body slide, and the highest-value buyer in this batch had not. If the pattern repeats, 'neglected health' may be describing the marketing story rather than the customer.
